03 / ABOUT

The person behind the browser tab.

I'm Andy Mutale, a software engineer based in South Africa.

Most of my work sits somewhere between interface design, frontend engineering, systems and experimentation.

I've spent a lot of time building for the web, but the interesting projects tend to escape those boundaries. Games, 3D, simulation, infrastructure, tools and ideas that seemed reasonable at the time.
